events.summary: The Dark God invades the valley; Alaric's village is destroyed.
Gawain finds Alaric alive and arranges his adoption in a neighboring settlement.
Alaric leaves his adoptive family to pursue the path toward the Dragon Rider Order.
Alaric works with caravans and learns blacksmithing and weaponsmithing.
Religious counsel sends Alaric to Silverdale, where he is connected with Eloran.
Alaric learns plantsmithing and Dragon Rider combat disciplines in the elven city.
Mortag's army enters the valley and the decisive defense culminates at Castle Tarn.
Alaric is knighted as the first human Dragon Rider Knight after his intervention against Mortag.
By the Champion period Alaric rides the sapphire-blue dragon Vaelor.
Galahad retires and Alaric becomes one of the three paladins alongside Gawain and Percival.
Alaric sees a future in which passive defense leads to the valley's destruction.
The Lady of the Lake gives Alaric the Sword of the Dawn in the Forest of Faron.
The Dragon Rider Knights launch a direct airborne assault on the Dark God's domain.
Alaric kills the Dark God with the Sword of the Dawn in the throne room.

uncertainties: Exact elapsed years between several middle-story milestones are not stated explicitly.
